assertions.title: db doctor is read-only on an existing DB

steps.action: Created an isolated git repo and a project DB under temp repo/.nya-cli/index.sqlite
steps.expected: A valid existing DB is available for doctor to inspect
steps.observed: Repo initialized and DB created with metadata, source manifest, and search tables

steps.action: Snapshotted main DB, WAL/SHM sidecars, and manifest/rebuild-related SQL state before doctor
steps.expected: Baseline state recorded with no sidecar changes
steps.observed: Before: db={'exists': True, 'path': '/tmp/nya-cli-db-readonly-lddhbmul/repo/.nya-cli/index.sqlite', 'size': 40960, 'sha256': '1c8866223cccfe0b85c8261153675bbaec0e758d1ce82cc980befca1189d2e4d'}; wal={'exists': False, 'path': '/tmp/nya-cli-db-readonly-lddhbmul/repo/.nya-cli/index.sqlite-wal'}; shm={'exists': False, 'path': '/tmp/nya-cli-db-readonly-lddhbmul/repo/.nya-cli/index.sqlite-shm'}

steps.action: Ran `bun run src/index.ts db doctor --project --json --no-tui` in the temp repo
steps.expected: Command exits 0 and reports an existing healthy DB
steps.observed: exit=0; stdout={'scope': 'project', 'dbPath': '/tmp/nya-cli-db-readonly-lddhbmul/repo/.nya-cli/index.sqlite', 'dbExists': True, 'healthStatus': 'ok', 'needsRebuild': False, 'rebuildReason': None, 'hasFts': True, 'hasVector': True, 'fingerprint': {'provider': 'google', 'model': 'fixture-model', 'dimensions': 4, 'taskType': 'RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT', 'chunkingVersion': 'v1', 'chunker': 'tree-sitter'}, 'sourceManifests': 1, 'failedSourceManifests': 0}

steps.action: Snapshotted main DB, WAL/SHM sidecars, and manifest/rebuild-related SQL state after doctor
steps.observed: After: db={'exists': True, 'path': '/tmp/nya-cli-db-readonly-lddhbmul/repo/.nya-cli/index.sqlite', 'size': 40960, 'sha256': '1c8866223cccfe0b85c8261153675bbaec0e758d1ce82cc980befca1189d2e4d'}; wal={'exists': False, 'path': '/tmp/nya-cli-db-readonly-lddhbmul/repo/.nya-cli/index.sqlite-wal'}; shm={'exists': False, 'path': '/tmp/nya-cli-db-readonly-lddhbmul/repo/.nya-cli/index.sqlite-shm'}

summary: VAL-DB-021 passed: `db doctor` left the project DB unchanged, and no `index.sqlite-wal`/`index.sqlite-shm` sidecars were created or modified.
